description: PHP class 'sysinfo' providing system information functions for HP-UX, including hostname, IP, kernel, uptime, CPU info, memory, filesystems, and network statistics.

classes.name: sysinfo
classes.description: A PHP class providing system information functions specific to HP-UX operating system.

methods.name: vhostname
methods.description: Returns the Apache SERVER_NAME or virtual host name.

methods.name: chostname
methods.description: Returns the canonical hostname using the 'hostname' command.

methods.name: ip_addr
methods.description: Returns the IP address of the server.

methods.name: users
methods.description: Returns the number of logged-in users.

methods.name: sbus
methods.description: Placeholder for SBus device info (not implemented).

methods.name: memory
methods.description: Retrieves memory and swap usage details.

methods.name: filesystems
methods.description: Retrieves filesystem mount and usage info.

methods.name: distroicon
methods.description: Returns the icon filename for the distribution.
